how: uv run python tools/mutants.py docs/quantities/qt-a3d/mutants.json --no-baseline --evidence docs/quantities/qt-a3d/evidence/mutants-run.json, after a passing build. Each mutant is applied alone; its command rebuilds VE.Cardinality.RunExamples, so a #guard there or a proof of a module it imports must fail; the harness restores the file's exact bytes. CardReport.Sound and runCase have trust_mutants' mutants (trust-mutants.json).

mutants.claim: a leaf dropped from the claim graph's report
command: cd lean && PATH=$HOME/.elan/bin:$PATH lake build VE.Cardinality.RunExamples
mutants.test: VE/Cardinality/RunExamples.lean qt-a3d guards: FA1's four leaves (leafNames, the leaves' meaning ids, the whole answer)

mutants.claim: a premise's leaf dropped when the leaves are joined
command: cd lean && PATH=$HOME/.elan/bin:$PATH lake build VE.Cardinality.RunExamples
mutants.test: proof union_mem (Document.lean); VE/Cardinality/RunExamples.lean qt-a3d guards: twoLevel's leaves

mutants.claim: a root admitted with an unproved leaf: a certificate that does not close accepted
mutants.find: checkErased ps c table ep (← Run.idsOf w ep) cert
mutants.replace: (checkErased ps c table ep (← Run.idsOf w ep) cert).map fun _ => true
command: cd lean && PATH=$HOME/.elan/bin:$PATH lake build VE.Cardinality.RunExamples
mutants.test: VE/Cardinality/RunExamples.lean qt-a3d guards: FA1b's certificate refused (graphRejected)

mutants.claim: a root admitted with an unproved leaf: the graph keeps a node whose certificate is false
mutants.replace:
| .ok false => checkGraph w check ns cost
            (acc ++ [⟨n.name, n.adm, n.size, union (children.map (·.leaves))⟩])
command: cd lean && PATH=$HOME/.elan/bin:$PATH lake build VE.Cardinality.RunExamples

mutants.find: if acc.any (·.name == n.name) then .error graphRejected else
command: cd lean && PATH=$HOME/.elan/bin:$PATH lake build VE.Cardinality.RunExamples
mutants.test: VE/Cardinality/RunExamples.lean qt-a3d guards: a second node named total refused

mutants.claim: a deduction's premises are the request's
mutants.find: | .ok ps, .ok c => pure (some (← strings ps, ← decodeCert c))
command: cd lean && PATH=$HOME/.elan/bin:$PATH lake build VE.Cardinality.RunExamples
mutants.test: proof decodeNode_statement (Document.lean); VE/Cardinality/RunExamples.lean qt-a3d guards: FA1 as a claim graph

command: cd lean && PATH=$HOME/.elan/bin:$PATH lake build VE.Cardinality.RunExamples
mutants.test: VE/Cardinality/RunExamples.lean qt-a3d guards: no documents@1 refused

mutants.find: if array.size > maxGraphNodes then throw nodeLimit
mutants.replace: if array.size ≥ maxGraphNodes then throw nodeLimit
command: cd lean && PATH=$HOME/.elan/bin:$PATH lake build VE.Cardinality.RunExamples

mutants.claim: 50,000 statement nodes are read by the deductions
mutants.find: if cost > maxDeductionNodes then .error deductionLimit else
mutants.replace: if cost ≥ maxDeductionNodes then .error deductionLimit else
command: cd lean && PATH=$HOME/.elan/bin:$PATH lake build VE.Cardinality.RunExamples
mutants.test: VE/Cardinality/RunExamples.lean qt-a3d guards: charged2 top3 24985 reaches P3

mutants.claim: the charge is over the whole graph
command: cd lean && PATH=$HOME/.elan/bin:$PATH lake build VE.Cardinality.RunExamples
mutants.test: VE/Cardinality/RunExamples.lean qt-a3d guards: charged2 top 24986 refused (50,001 with mid's 27)

mutants.claim: CardReport (trusted, S): the root and its leaves
mutants.find:
structure CardReport where
  root : CFormula
  leaves : List CFormula
mutants.replace:
structure CardReport where
  root : CFormula
  leaves : List CFormula := []
  extra : CFormula
command: cd lean && PATH=$HOME/.elan/bin:$PATH lake build VE.Cardinality.RunExamples
mutants.test: Graph.report's anonymous constructor (Document.lean) does not elaborate
